narr: A cold front pushed into a moist and unstable airmass resulting in numerous showers and thunderstorms across West Tennesee and North Mississippi during the early morning hours of March 31st. Heavy rainfall resulted in flash flooding while a few severe storms produced damaging winds and a couple of weak tornado across Northeast Mississippi.
ev: Flooding occurred across parts of Monroe County. Several inches of water flooded an apartment in Amory. Multiple roads were closed in and around Hatley. Adams road was completely underwater and impassable.
Highway 8 was closed between Church Street and Martin Luther King Drive due to flooding.
Swift-water rescues occurred around Calhoun City.
Several roads flooded in Houston. Some rescues occurred in Houston.
